subject: INITIATE statement
notes: kb/Work PB326, landed. An INITIATE of an ACTIVE report calls ExceptionState.ReportActiveError (raise gated by >>TURN) and returns; 'the execution of the INITIATE statement has no other effect' is unconditional, so GR1a-c do not re-run. The golden witnesses exactly that with a SUM counter: the refused second INITIATE does not re-zero it, so the control footing prints S=008 (4+4) rather than S=004. At COBOL-85 there is no >>TURN directive at all, so only the lenient half is observable there — and it is the half that was already correct; what this landing adds is the named condition and the chance to handle it. kb/Work PB688 (2026-09-05): the golden moved from tests/conformance/2002 to tests/conformance/2023 - it observes the report by re-reading the report file through ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, which is a COBOL-2023 introduction (12.4.5.10.3 GR2; the Foreword's main-changes list over ISO/IEC 1989:2014), so the program is not expressible at 2002. The RULE's editions are unchanged.
